summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 4,117,648 common shares at $85.00, raising a base $350.0M; gross proceeds assume no exercise of the 617,647-share, 30-day underwriters' option. The October 2, 2026 last sale was $93.19, implying a ~8.8% discount. Jefferies, TD Cowen, Leerink and Stifel are joint book-running managers; LifeSci Capital is passive bookrunner. Delivery is expected on or about October 7, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and use of proceeds.
